responsibility: Implements gm2’s replayable token stream with full source-location tracking. It buffers tokens emitted by `m2flex` in bucketed storage, reserves token numbers for unknown and builtins locations, maintains include-file/source stacks with line and column origins, supports insertion and rewinding for reparsing, maps token numbers to file/line/column and `location_t`, and can synthesize virtual range tokens from existing source tokens for richer diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the M2LexBuf pair: it manages bucketed token storage, inserted-token streams, include-file/source stacks, token-number to location mapping, and virtual range-token creation for `m2flex`, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2LexBuf.def` only declares those services.
